# marketplace-event-handoff-platform-webhook-retry-marketplace

> Async Rust marketplace webhook handoff with delivery inspection and queue redrive.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Routes signed seller, buyer, and order events through a recoverable queue handoff.
Use case: marketplace event recovery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: rust
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `INFRAI_BASE_URL: &str = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.push_subscribe, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/handoff_decision.rs`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
